triage.fix_rationale: The lobby wait constants and per-test timeout live in the e2e specs and the Playwright config. Raising them, or cutting the work done at lobby startup, is the usual fix.
triage.hypothesis: The aubade lobby never finished loading ("Unlocking the lobby" never hid) within the 20s wait and the 30s test timeout. The lazy chunk, shader compile and CPU-rasterised raymarch on the GPU-less CI runner are too slow, so every aubade test timed out.
